title.narrative: Moving Zimbabwe Towards Malaria Elimination: strengthening evidence based programming - Zimbabwe (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Zimbabwe, Malaria, The Ministry of Health and Child Care of the Republic of Zimbabwe (MOHCC)This program has the following goals: To reduce malaria incidence to 5/1000 and malaria deaths by at least 90% by 2025 and accelerate towards malaria elimination.. The objectives of this program are: To accelerate transition from Covid 19 pandemic response mode to a more robust resilient and sustainable health systems capable of dealing with any potential future pandemic. To ensure that availed resources are strategically and equitably allocated to the need priorities and utilized to optimize quality health service delivery whilst avoiding duplication to achieve value for money.. To strengthen leadership, professional development, and resource management within community-led organizations.. Strengthen community-led and based organizations' capacity to respond to disease outbreaks and emergencies.. To increase utilization of malaria interventions to at least 85% of the targeted population by 2025. To strengthen surveillance, monitoring and evaluation and operational research for all malaria interventions for the period 2021-2025.. To foster an enabling environment for optimal program implementation and impact.
